items.title: Select carbide-shank boring bars when L/D exceeds 6:1 to limit harmonic vibration amplitude below 0.05 mm in finish passes
items.formula: Carbide shank required if L/D > 6.0; steel limited to L/D = 4.5 max.
items.cite: Sandvik Coromant Turning Technical Guide CTG-2022, p. 89, section 4.2 "Boring Bar Rigidity".

items.title: Choose 93° lead angle holders over 80° for external turning when 90° shoulder tolerance is tighter than ±0.02 mm to eliminate witness lines
items.formula: Use 93° holder if shoulder angle = 90° ±0.5° and diametral tolerance < 0.04 mm.
items.cite: Kennametal Turning & Grooving Catalog 2021, p. 37, "External Holder Geometry Selection".

items.title: Select hydraulic expansion holders when part diameter tolerance is IT6 or better to keep tool runout under 0.003 mm TIR
items.formula: Hydraulic holder if tolerance < ±0.008 mm on diameter; standard ER limited to ±0.025 mm.
items.cite: Big Kaiser Precision Tooling Handbook, 2020, p. 51, section "Holder Runout vs Tolerance".

items.title: Use negative-rake C-type holders with 7° clearance exclusively on Inconel 718 when DOC exceeds 2.5 mm to prevent depth-of-cut notching
items.formula: 7° clearance negative if DOC > 2.5 mm and nickel alloy hardness > 38 HRC.
items.cite: Iscar Metal Cutting Technical Guide 2018, p. 134, "High-Temp Alloy Tool Selection".

items.title: Select modular Capto C6 holders over standard square shank when cutting speed > 250 m/min on alloy steel to maintain balance grade G2.5
items.formula: Capto C6 if Vc > 250 m/min and tool mass > 1.2 kg.
items.cite: Coromant Capto System Guide 2019, p. 28, "High-Speed Holder Interface".

items.title: Deploy 35° diamond
items.formula: V35 holder if min concave radius ≤ 0.8 mm; 80° diamond limited to radii ≥ 1.2 mm.
items.cite: Mitsubishi Materials Turning Tools Catalog MT2021, p. 62, "Insert Angle vs Feature Radius".

items.title: Select through-coolant parting holders with minimum 70 bar capability when feed rate on cutoff exceeds 0.15 mm/rev on stainless to prevent c
items.formula: 70 bar coolant holder if feed ≥ 0.15 mm/rev on 300-series SS and blade width < 4 mm.
items.cite: Seco Grooving & Parting Technical Manual 2022, p. 81, "Cutoff Tooling Pressure Thresholds".

items.title: Increase feed rate to direct over 70% of generated heat into the removable chip rather than tool or workpiece
items.formula: Minimum feed 0.18 mm/rev for carbon steels at 150-250 m/min surface speed.
items.cite: Sandvik Coromant Metal Cutting Technology 3rd Ed, p. 67 Section 4.2.

items.title: Program diameter oversize on finish pass to compensate for thermal contraction to cold target dimension
items.formula: delta D = D × 11.7e-6 × 35 using 11.7 ppm/°C for alloy steel and 35°C typical rise.
items.cite: Machinery's Handbook 31st Ed, p. 1265 "Allowances for Thermal Expansion".

items.title: Maintain water-soluble coolant at precise 8-10% concentration for peak heat removal capacity
items.formula: Below 6% concentration heat transfer coefficient falls 27% from 4.18 kJ/kg·K baseline.
items.cite: Blaser Swisslube Coolant Technology Guide, p. 14 "Concentration Effects".

items.title: Select CVD inserts having thick Al2O3 outer layer when tool-tip temperature exceeds 850°C in continuous cut
items.formula: Al2O3 layer withstands 900-1250°C reducing crater wear rate by factor of 3.5 above 950°C.
items.cite: Kennametal Turning Grade Selection Manual 2020, Section C p. 51.

items.title: Deploy SiC-whisker reinforced alumina ceramics for hardened steel turning above 45 HRC to tolerate >1050°C
items.formula: Safe Vc threshold 175 m/min maximum at 0.5 mm DOC on 55 HRC material.
items.cite: Greenleaf Advanced Ceramics Handbook, p. 22 "WG-300 Thermal Limits".

items.title: Insert 4-second dwells every 30 mm axial distance in long stainless roughing with sub-20 bar coolant
items.formula: Dwell interval = cut length / 8 with minimum 4 s to drop interface temp below 750°C.
items.cite: Seco Turning Application Guide 2021, p. 61 "Heat Dissipation Tactics".

items.title: Mandate flood coolant and cap surface speed on magnesium to keep chip temperature below ignition threshold
items.formula: Maximum Vc 130 m/min with minimum 15 L/min water-based flow to stay under 420°C.
items.cite: ASM Handbook Vol 16 Machining, p. 685 "Magnesium Safety Practices".

items.title: **Rule** – Keep spindle speed at ≤ 80 % of the critical cutting speed to avoid chatter on finish passes.
**Rule** – For a given nose radius, maintain surface roughness \(R_z\) ≤ \(h^2/(8R)\) to achieve sub‑micron finish.
**Rule** – Keep chip load per tooth between 0.04–0.08 mm for high‑speed steel finish passes.
**Rule** – Maintain coolant pressure ≥ 200 kPa to keep the lubricant film thickness < 50 µm during finish passes.
**Rule** – RMS acceleration during finish passes must stay below 0.2 g to avoid surface waviness.
**Rule** – Tool deflection must not exceed 0.02 mm for finish passes on 50 mm workpieces.
**Rule** – Use a 10‑point average \(R_z\) measurement; keep it ≤ 1 µm for finish passes on 5 mm diameter parts.
